notes.r2135_acyl_coa_pool_evidence: m1984 is MetaNetX MNXM1136895 acyl-CoA, the same id and Reactome R-ALL-2534017 as the ER-membrane pooled acyl-CoA m567; its only consumers R2134 and R2168 are KEGG R01496 / R02251, which use acyl-CoA C00040, not acetyl-CoA C00024.
notes.r2135_acyl_coa_pool_limits: Inherited from iYli21 with no recorded reason. The pool-to-pool link is a species-identity correction, not a measured transport; m567 and m1984 have no formulas, so mass balance cannot be checked. As written, the reaction let acetyl-CoA stand in for long-chain acyl-CoA in TAG synthesis.
notes.r2135_acyl_coa_pool_authorization: User authorized the m68 to m567 remap on 2026-10-27.

notes.r2145_rescale_evidence: ModelSEED rxn09551 carries 0.01 on its lumped yeast-specific PA / DAG; in this model m1993 and m1994 are linked 1:1 to per-molecule PA and DAG (R2144, R2169), so the 0.01 form released one phosphate per 0.01 PA. Written as PA + H2O = DAG + Pi (EC 3.1.3.4).
notes.r2145_rescale_limits: m1993 and m1994 have no formulas, so mass balance cannot be checked. Other 0.01-scaled reactions of the R2143-R2187 block are not changed.
notes.r2145_rescale_sources: ModelSEED rxn09551 (Solr query, see the curation file); https://www.kegg.jp/entry/yli:2911239
